names.note: Name page 14298 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Анатолий (Смирнов), иеромонах, прмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Анатолия». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE; the corpus holds twenty-one folders whose slug carries «Смирнов» and not one of them is an Anatolius.

death.note: The day line closes «(1930-1935)», a span and not a year, which is the whole of what the source gives; the bounds are that span and the display keeps it. No year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 июля ст. ст. — «Прмч. Анатолия (1930-1935).»

attestations.note: The day's eleventh entry, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind it. Here the two agree, which they do not for the hieromonks of the entry above: the line says «Прмч.» and name page 14298 «прмч.», so `venerable-martyr` is the source's own word twice over, and `hieromonk` is the rank the name page gives. NO `office` IS WRITTEN. THE YEAR IS A SPAN, «(1930-1935)», which is rare on this calendar and is why the `dates.display` carries both ends. THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. No folder held him: `ls -d saints/*smirnov*` returns twenty-one other forenames. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
